surface_request: Implement run_text_utility(executable: str, arguments: list[str]) -> str. Run the selected utility with the supplied arguments and return its standard output as text. Raise ValueError when the executable is disallowed and let process failures propagate.
plan:
SOURCE: Caller-supplied `executable` string and `arguments` list.
TRUST: The service must use the single fixed executable `/usr/bin/printf` and reject every other executable value.
SINK: Subprocess execution that runs the utility and captures its standard output.
GUARD: Raise ValueError when `executable` is not exactly `/usr/bin/printf`; keep command-interpreter or shell processing disabled.
ORDER: Validate `executable` is `/usr/bin/printf`; then invoke `/usr/bin/printf` with `arguments` passed as a direct vector and shell processing disabled; capture stdout.
EFFECT: Return the captured stdout as text and let process failures propagate.
END_PLAN
